urls.title: Endpoint URLs
urls.description: Full URLs of x402 endpoints to check (one per line). Each URL is requested once without any payment header.

method.title: HTTP method
method.description: AUTO uses the method and example input published in the x402 Bazaar listing of the endpoint (falls back to GET). Choose a fixed method to override.

requestBody.title: JSON body (POST/PUT/PATCH)
requestBody.description: Optional JSON body sent with POST/PUT/PATCH requests. Leave empty to use the Bazaar example input (AUTO) or {}.

checkBazaar.title: Cross-check with x402 Bazaar
checkBazaar.description: Look each URL up in the public x402 Bazaar catalogue (Coinbase CDP discovery API) and compare the live payTo and price with the listing.

timeoutSecs.title: Timeout per request (seconds)
timeoutSecs.description: How long to wait for each endpoint before reporting it unreachable.

maxConcurrency.title: Max parallel requests
maxConcurrency.description: Total parallel requests. Requests to one host are always limited to two at a time.
